mainEntity.name: Which is cheaper, Hostinger or Bluehost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month and renews at $10.99. Bluehost Starter is $3.99 and renews at $9.99.

mainEntity.name: Does Bluehost have a Black Friday sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes: 15% off one product, 20% off two or 25% off three or more, first 12-month term only, to 30 November 2026.

mainEntity.name: Which has more sites on the entry plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bluehost Starter lists 10 sites. Hostinger Premium lists 3.
